configuration.nominalHoleSource: bha.holeSize = 16 in (study Bit Size; no explicit bore override)
configuration.conditionalAssumption: DP only: hypothetical long uniform initially straight zero-torque frictionless-onset local comparison. Not confirmation of actual compressed-section stability.

reasons: Vertical or over-horizontal interval: outside the implemented inclined-well criterion.
Long, uniform, initially straight tubular, zero-torque and frictionless-onset idealization has not been confirmed for this component.
Curved interval: no supported curved-well criterion implemented.

warnings: Preliminary analytical screening, not operational guidance or a safe Jar Down force.
Named long-tubular frictionless-onset criteria; finite-length, end-restraint and frictional stability effects are not resolved.
The existing pre-buckling slack-off force profile is unchanged; no post-buckling redistribution is calculated.
Below-jar buckling is not evaluated. The existing lower-assembly reaction assumption is retained.
Exceeding an onset threshold is not a prediction of failure, release or firing.
Preliminary quasi-static screening; not operational guidance or a manufacturer operating limit.
The lower assembly is assumed to provide the necessary reaction. Its support capacity and movement are not calculated.
Fully mobilised nonrotating axial friction is assumed, not actual pre-slip friction or a measured parked state.
Jar load is at its centre, including the upper half of the jar; it is not a manufacturer internal firing force.
No impact, impulse, waves, stroke, time delay, pressure-end forces, buckling, lockup or contact stiffness is predicted.
Buoyancy assumes steel density 65.5 ppg and equal internal/external fluid.
Compression is propagated on the imposed survey centreline; physical stability of that compressed configuration is not established.
